SELECTED_INDEX: 7
CONFIDENCE: 0.62
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a typical aliphatic CH-stretch envelope (2829–2952 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003) and a strong CH2 deformation near 1469 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), consistent with an ethoxyalkyl chain. The presence of two C–O stretching bands at ~1045 and ~1158 cm⁻¹ matches the expected primary alcohol (≈1045 cm⁻¹) plus ether (≈1120–1160 cm⁻¹) features, and the CH2 rocking/wagging region shows bands at 860–876 cm⁻¹ with a skeletal/rocking mode near 779 cm⁻¹, all characteristic of 2-ethoxyethanol (CCOCCO). This pattern fits candidate 7 better than branched/secondary alcohol ethers (e.g., 1 or 3), which would shift the alcohol C–O stretch higher (~1100–1120 cm⁻¹).
